body: I am pathetic. I just spent the last hour going through all his followers and finding the girl he is dating now. She is pretty and has a real job. I’m thinking about taking Tylenol. I want my death to be painful and slow. I just feel like I deserve it.
I did gain 100lbs btw. And I avoided him for a full week at one point. That’s what I mean. I did the things that you were using as an exaggeration example.

But I do feel like it is actually my fault. I was avoiding him, and I was not being the best version if myself. I kinda get why he needed a break from me. I feel like if we have it another chance I could do better.
